item.title: Arnold, Maryland
item.description: Arnold is a charming waterfront community on the Severn River in Anne Arundel County, known for its historic downtown, seafood restaurants, and ferry to Annapolis.

item.title: Severn, Maryland
item.description: Severn is a suburban community in central Anne Arundel County along the Severn River, offering residential neighborhoods, parks, and proximity to Annapolis.
